messages:
Emily Carter: quick ask — we need a small batch of launch assets for the benchmark webinar and 3 social posts. looking for 3 illustration directions (abstract cloud, product-focus, data-visual motif), each with 3 size variants + copy variants. brand compliance required. can design team take? :pray:
Samir Patel: Yup — can do. quick Qs: 1) deadline? 2) do you want flat illustrations or light gradients? 3) any mandatory photography?
Emily Carter: Target ship for review by Tue 10am PT (48hrs). prefer flat + subtle gradients for depth, no customer photos. must meet our color contrast WCAG AA.
Samir Patel: Got it. for sizes I'll produce: `instagram_square_1080x1080.svg`, `twitter_landscape_1200x675.svg`, `web_banner_1920x480.svg`. Also export PNG @2x for social ads. Any CTA copy constraints?
Michael Nguyen: Copy notes — keep primary headline <= 90 chars, supporting line <= 140. CTA candidates: "Try Redwood Inference", "See benchmark results", "Register for the webinar". also want one experimental punchy line for social: "Inference that doesn't break the bank."
Jia Li: For inbound routing: please include UTM placeholders in final filenames: `utm_campaign={campaign}`. Also include a plain-text copy file for each asset with recommended alt text and recommended audience tags (devs / platform / enterprise).
Samir Patel: Cool. I'll add an `assets_manifest.csv` with columns: filename, size, alt_text, utm_template, audience, license. Any brand constraints beyond contrast?
Emily Carter: Also: no gradients that interfere with readability of branded logotype. Stick to approved type scale: H1 36/44, H2 28/36, Body 16/24. Use hero type token `redwood-display-700` for headlines.
Samir Patel: ACK — I'll produce 3 directions x 3 sizes x 3 copy variants = 27 files + PNGs + manifest. Plan: first sketches (vector thumbnails) by EOD tomorrow, hi-fi comps by Tue AM.
Michael Nguyen: I'll prepare the 3 copy variants and short alt texts, will drop in the shared doc: https://figma.com/file/placeholder/launch-brief (link later).
Jia Li: Ops note — for the webinar page we need a 16:9 hero (1280x720) as well. please add that size to the list and include SVG + PNG.
design-bot: Brand check reminder — please run `brand-qa --contrast --logo-safezone` before final export. Reaction :white_check_mark:
Emily Carter: thank you! one last ask — can one of the illustration directions be optimized for low-bandwidth (smaller file weight, simplified shapes)? mark those files with `_lite` suffix.
Samir Patel: Yep — will include `_lite` variants and a note in manifest about expected file sizes. tagging this thread as high priority.
Emily Carter: perfect. ping me in this thread when sketches are uploaded. :rocket:
